continuity: Taekyung completed one year of training in the Fire Gate Cavern and left it with Jeok Cheongang, formally referring to himself as Jeok's unworthy Disciple.
Taekyung can freely enter and exit the Fire Gate Cavern using the internal energy of the Scorching Sun Divine Arts.
Taekyung still wears numerous iron balls chained to all four limbs after completing the year of training.
Jeok Cheongang had harvested all the spiritual herbs on Mount Jiuhua before descending with Taekyung.
Taekyung gave a remaining ginseng root to Hong, a struggling herbalist from Sichuan, and arranged its sale to passing martial artists.
Namgung Ryong appeared at Mount Jiuhua with dozens of highly trained martial artists, paid three hundred silver nyang for the ginseng, and identified himself as the Family Head of the Nangong Family.
Jeok Cheongang's description establishes Namgung Ryong as the richest man in Anhui.
plot: After a year of training in the Fire Gate Cavern, Jin Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang leave the cavern. Taekyung can open its stone gate with the internal energy of the Scorching Sun Divine Arts and departs while still wearing iron balls chained to all four limbs.

At the foot of Mount Jiuhua, they encounter Hong, a herbalist from Sichuan who has found no spiritual herbs. Jeok has already harvested the mountain's herbs, but Taekyung gives Hong a remaining ginseng root and sells it to a group of martial artists for one hundred silver nyang. Namgung Ryong then raises the price to three hundred silver nyang to compensate Jeok for offending him, identifies himself as the Family Head of the Nangong Family, and is described as the richest man in Anhui.
translation_decisions: Retain Old Master for Taekyung's private address 노야 to Jeok Cheongang.
Render 신령님 as Mountain Spirit when Hong mistakes Jeok Cheongang for a supernatural being.
Keep samgyeopsal as samgyeopsal with a pork-belly explanation, and preserve the Sichuan Province tile-game pun in the yaja exchange.

active_continuity: Wipeng returned to the Jin Family of Taiyuan after four months commanding the campaign to stabilize Northern Gaoyuan.
The Jin Dragon Squad is the Jin Family's foremost armed force; Wipeng commands it, and Hyuk Mujin served as acting Deputy Commander during his absence.
The Seven-Route Army killed or captured two thousand mounted bandits, annihilated five major groups, and forced more than ten others to surrender.
The Lower District Sect supported the campaign with intelligence operations, and Jin Wikyung considers Wolhwa's strategy her true weapon.
Temur and Chinggen each command two thousand riders and now seek friendship with the Jin Family after absorbing the remnants of defeated mounted-bandit powers.
Jeok Cheongang killed Black Sand and the Human Butcher with one palm strike and later annihilated the Heavenly Wind Band, creating a power vacuum in Gaoyuan.
The Seongun Escort Bureau is effectively now the Jin Family Escort Bureau after Woo Hwangtae's family fled over diverted military supplies.
The Jin Family is conducting favorable trade cooperation with Shaolin and Namgung through Mount Song and Hefei.
Jin Wikyung titled a planned painting The Sleeping Dragon Enters Service.
A year has passed since Jin Taekyung left for training with Jeok Cheongang; the brothers are expected to meet at the Star-Array Grand Banquet in Henan.
Jeok Cheongang's increasing sleep and memory lapses have led Taekyung to recognize that he is suffering from dementia.
Jeok Cheongang publicly accepted Taekyung as his Disciple and heir to the Fire Gate Clan's orthodox lineage, and began transmitting the clan's inheritance.
Taekyung completed a year of training in the Fire Gate Cavern and departed Mount Jiuhua with Jeok Cheongang while still wearing chained iron balls.
Jeok Cheongang had already harvested Mount Jiuhua's spiritual herbs before descending.
Taekyung gave a remaining ginseng root to Hong, a Sichuan herbalist, and sold it to passing martial artists.
Namgung Ryong arrived with dozens of trained martial artists, paid three hundred silver nyang for the ginseng, and identified himself as the Family Head of the Nangong Family.
Jeok Cheongang described Namgung Ryong as the richest man in Anhui.
open_questions: How quickly will Jeok Cheongang's dementia progress, and how much time does he have to teach Taekyung?
Why has Namgung Ryong committed the family's intelligence network to investigating Taekyung?
What important matter does Jin Wikyung need to discuss privately with Jeok Cheongang?
Did Mae Jonghak actually grant Cheongpung permission to become Jeok's Disciple, and where is Mae now?
Will Baek Museong escort Cheongpung to Huashan or search the Central Plains for Mae Jonghak?
Will Jin Mukyung eventually attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet?
What is the unknowable calamity approaching as the heavenly patterns become distorted?
What does Dark Heaven intend, and how is it connected to the approaching calamity?
